questions.text: By 2030, what will happen to many jobs according to reading 1?
opts: They will disappear and be replaced by AI
They will move to other countries
questions.correct: They will disappear and be replaced by AI
questions.hint: Paragraph 1: "many jobs will disappear — replaced by artificial intelligence and automation."

questions.text: Amir dreams of working in international education.
questions.hint: Paragraph 5: Amir wants to become a software engineer; Kamila wants to work in international education.

questions.text: What does Nurlan (Kamila's brother) do at 9:30 a.m.?
questions.hint: Reading 2, paragraph 2: "He has a team meeting at 9:30."

questions.text: What does Nurlan do after work every day?
questions.hint: Reading 2, paragraph 5: "he goes for a run or does a workout."

questions.text: Zhibek hopes to start her own ___.
questions.hint: Reading 1, paragraph 5: "Zhibek hopes to start her own business."

questions.text: What kind of work does the internship involve?
questions.hint: Statement 2: "the internship involves working on real client projects."

questions.text: Amir is offered the internship position in the interview.
questions.hint: Statement 6: "She offers him the internship and says he will start in July."

questions.text: What did Amir say about working in a team?
opts: He loves solving problems and works well in a team
He has never worked in a team
questions.correct: He loves solving problems and works well in a team
questions.hint: Statement 3: "He says he works well in a team and loves solving problems."

questions.text: When does Amir's internship start?
questions.hint: Statement 6: "he will start in July."

questions.text: Amir led his group project when the ___ leader was ill.
questions.hint: Statement 5 describes how Amir stepped up as the team leader.

questions.text: "Apply ___ a job" — which preposition?
questions.hint: "apply for" = to formally request consideration for a job.

questions.text: "___ a mistake" — which verb?
questions.hint: "make a mistake" = the standard collocation.

questions.text: She ___ her best during the interview.
questions.hint: "do your best" = the correct collocation.

questions.text: "___ notes" — which verb?
questions.hint: "take notes" = the standard collocation.

questions.text: "Do a meeting" is standard English.
questions.hint: Correct: "have a meeting" or "attend a meeting." "Do a meeting" is not standard.

questions.text: She ___ (earn) a promotion after just one year.
questions.hint: "earn a promotion" = the correct collocation. Past simple here.

questions.text: "___ progress" — which verb?
questions.hint: "make progress" = the standard collocation.

questions.text: "Work ___ a software engineer" — which preposition?
questions.hint: "work as + profession" = describe your role.

questions.text: They ___ a great meeting and agreed on the project plan.
questions.hint: "have a meeting" = the correct collocation.

questions.text: "She works ___ a tech startup in Almaty" — which preposition?
questions.hint: "work for + company" = describe your employer.

questions.text: "Career prospects" means:
opts: Future opportunities for advancement in your career
questions.correct: Future opportunities for advancement in your career
questions.hint: "Prospects" = possibilities or chances for the future.

questions.text: "Automation" means:
opts: Using machines/AI to do tasks previously done by humans
questions.correct: Using machines/AI to do tasks previously done by humans
questions.hint: "Automation" = replacing human tasks with technology.

questions.text: An "internship" is a permanent full-time job.
questions.hint: "Internship" = temporary work experience, usually for students.

questions.text: She has years of ___ in marketing and is very skilled.
questions.hint: "Expertise" = a high level of skill or knowledge from experience.

questions.text: "Sector" in an economic context means:
opts: A group or area of the economy or society
questions.correct: A group or area of the economy or society
questions.hint: "Sector" = a division or part, e.g. the healthcare sector, the IT sector.

questions.text: "Adapt" means:
opts: To change to fit new conditions
questions.correct: To change to fit new conditions
questions.hint: "Adapt" = to adjust to new situations or requirements.

questions.text: "Work-life balance" means working as many hours as possible.
questions.hint: "Work-life balance" = managing time so that both work and personal life have appropriate time.

questions.text: "Startup" refers to:
opts: A new company in its early stages
questions.correct: A new company in its early stages
questions.hint: "Startup" = a newly founded company, often in tech, with innovative ideas.

questions.text: "Feedback" in a work context means:
opts: Comments given to someone about their performance or work
questions.correct: Comments given to someone about their performance or work
questions.hint: "Feedback" = information given to help someone improve or understand how they are doing.

questions.text: He plans to ___ for a summer internship at a tech company.
questions.hint: "apply for an internship" = the correct collocation.
